about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Brazil: 26 states and the Federal District, one region each. See docs/REGIONS-BR.md.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:BR unit codes: the prefix BR- and two letters, BR-AC to BR-TO.
codes.why: Seven two-letter codes (AL, MA, MS, MT, PA, PR, SC) are also codes in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py) for US states or Puerto Rico. carry_over() in engine/setup/install.py keeps only [A-Z]{2} address indexes (line 335), so the hyphenated name must be decided before any index is shipped.
codes.verified: The 27 codes were read from the Wikipedia article 'ISO 3166-2:BR' (opened 2026-11-20), which lists the names as in ISO 3166-2 from the ISO 3166/MA. The ISO Online Browsing Platform itself was not opened.

boxes.source: IBGE state polygons (malhas territoriais, estadual), read through the IBGE malhas API with qualidade=maxima on 2026-11-20. Second check: recomputed from IBGE Malha Municipal Digital 2022, state layer, full resolution (BR_UF_2022.zip, 13,717,460 bytes, SHA-256 282ec7f0f0beeeead45e6609f4ffffce161bda04cb8ee0afcad2316d1c841bcb, SIRGAS 2000, https://geoftp.ibge.gov.br/organizacao_do_territorio/malhas_territoriais/malhas_municipais/municipio_2022/Brasil/BR/BR_UF_2022.zip), downloaded 2026-11-18 and 2026-11-24.
boxes.method: Every vertex of every polygon was read; the box was widened by 0.15 degrees and rounded outward to 0.01 degrees (floor for west and south, ceiling for east and north), the same margin map_sets.state uses for US states.
boxes.islands: Detached polygons were checked for all 27 units (any polygon more than 0.5 degrees from the largest one). Two are in the IBGE polygons: Fernando de Noronha (BR-PE, kept) and Trindade and Martim Vaz (BR-ES, left out of the box). Atol das Rocas (RN) and São Pedro e São Paulo (PE) are not in the IBGE polygons.
boxes.licence_status: Settled (second check): IBGE releases the Malha Municipal Digital and all products derived from it under CC BY 4.0 (Notas metodológicas 01/2025, liv102169, opened). Credit IBGE.
boxes.cross_check: Every extent from the full-resolution file equals, to four decimals, the regiao-limitrofe that https://servicodados.ibge.gov.br/api/v3/malhas/estados/{id}/metadados reports (all 27 opened 2026-11-18; the eight changed units again 2026-11-24). The qualidade=maxima outline is simplified: it leaves out small islands and smooths the coast (second check, measured).

not_open_nationwide: Postcode areas: Brazil has no open CEP area layer that was checked. The CEP is eight digits; no CEP-to-state table was checked. Correios DNE is sold (second check). CNEFE carries COD_UF, so splitting by state does not need a CEP table (second check).
Dam inventory: no open national list was identified in the first pass. Second check: SNISB (ANA), 28,127 dams with coordinates; licence field empty, see ANA-open-data-statement.

Health establishments with coordinates (CNES) and state fire and police station lists were not checked in the first pass. Second check: CNES has coordinates; no open São Paulo state fire or police station list was found.

postal_code.format: Eight digits (CEP, Código de Endereçamento Postal), written 00000-000 with a hyphen after the fifth digit, for example 01311-000 (the Correios example). The Correios API accepts eight digits without the hyphen. Keep as text: leading zeros occur.
postal_code.verified: Correios Guia Técnico de Endereçamento de Correspondências (v1.4, 2021): search snippet only, PDF not opened. Second check: the guide (v1.4, 3 May 2021) and the Correios "Tudo sobre CEP" page opened.
postal_code.not_a_state_code: The first digit of a CEP is a broad region, not a state. No CEP-to-state table was checked, so address indexes cannot be split by state yet. Second check: CNEFE carries COD_UF, which answers this.
postal_code.structure: First digit: one of ten postal regions, numbered anticlockwise from São Paulo; next four: sub-region, sector, subsector, subsector divisor. Suffix: 000-899 streets, 900-959 special, 960-969 promotional, 970-989 and 999 Correios units, 990-998 community post boxes (opened, second check).
postal_code.dne: Correios CEP database (DNE) is a licensed, paid product: not open (opened, second check).

addressing.order: Street type, street name, number, then complement and neighbourhood, then city and state (UF), with the CEP last (Correios guide; search snippet only). Second check: guide opened; its example is 'Avenida Paulista 123, Loja B / Paraíso / 01311-000 São Paulo/SP'.
addressing.no_number: Correios writes SN (sem número) for no number; the CEP complement is then 00000 (search snippet only). Second check: the guide recommends 's/n' (opened); the data holds S/N and SN.
addressing.code_now: tools/build_addresses.py keeps only country = 'US'. engine/address_search.py normalize() replaces every character outside a-z and 0-9 with a space, so Portuguese accents split words (for example 'Ação' becomes 'a o'). is_address_query() needs a number first.

overture_brazil_count.note: Publisher's count, not made for this proposal.

addressing.street_types: Correios lists 41 types (rua, avenida, alameda, travessa, praça, estrada, rodovia, largo, viela, ladeira, vila, ...) and no abbreviation table. CNES São Paulo: RUA 57,882; AVENIDA 15,325; AV 9,578; R 5,986; also PRACA, ALAMEDA, AL, AVN, ROD, ESTRADA, TRAVESSA. Kilometres appear in the street field (ROD WASHINGTON LUIZ KM 234) (second check, measured).
code_tests_second_check: Street-first addresses (Av. Paulista, 1578 ...; Rua Conceição, 233 ...) are not treated as addresses; only 1578 Avenida Paulista is.
Typing without accents gives rua conceicao; the index holds rua concei o: no match.
normalize() street words are English: av becomes ave, avenida stays avenida, so Av Paulista and Avenida Paulista do not match.
A CEP is not read as a postcode (01310-200 becomes 01310 200); build_addresses.py left(postcode, 5) keeps 01310.
The place finder (FTS5 unicode61) already folds accents: sao paulo, ribeirao, conceicao, embu guacu all found.

open_questions: DF inside the BR-GO box: separate maps, or should the Goiás map include DF (as the Argentina proposal suggests for CABA)?
Should BR- hyphenated codes become file and manifest names, with carry_over widened to match? That change touches the upgrade path and needs review.
IBGE licence: the malhas are CC BY 4.0 (second check). Remaining: whether Localidades 2022 is a derived product under the same note, and how the map credits IBGE for CNEFE.
Trindade and Martim Vaz: a separate small map, or no map? No resident population was checked.
Atol das Rocas (RN) and São Pedro e São Paulo (PE): not in the IBGE polygons; should either have a map?

CEP: no open CEP-area source; Correios DNE is sold. Splitting by state no longer depends on it: CNEFE carries COD_UF (second check). Address search still needs eight-digit CEPs, number after the street, Portuguese street words and accent folding.

Water: ask ANA which licence applies to BHO 6 and ask CPRM for the SIAGAS data licence. Both fail the test until answered. Second check: ANA's open data page says its data are free of licence restrictions; this covers BHO 6 and SNISB alike, and whether it is enough is for the maintainers.
CNES: the dataset licence field says cc-by, but the portal footer says CC BY-ND for its site content. Maintainers should confirm which governs. The file has coordinates (second check).

Crop classes: MapBiomas Collection 11 classes are known (second check); which map to the orchard, vineyard and berry kinds in tools/build_crops.py, and confirm CC BY 4.0 against the CC BY-SA reading of the terms page.

osm_counts.method: Overpass API (overpass-api.de), one request per unit: area ISO3166-2 BR-XX with admin_level=4 (Brazil: ISO3166-1 BR, admin_level=2); nwr with each tag; out count. Counts are objects in OSM, not checked for duplicates or closed features.
osm_counts.note: MT natural=spring is marked not counted. Overpass gives 53,580. Split used: the IBGE tight box for BR-MT (W -61.6334, S -18.0416, E -50.2248, N -7.3490) cut at latitude -12.6953 and longitude -55.9291, each quarter intersected with the OSM BR-MT area: south-west 31,074, south-east 19,825, north-west 40, north-east 2,641 (sum 53,580; a whole-state count on 2026-11-21 gave the same total). 50,807 springs (31,006 south-west, 19,801 south-east) are in eight changesets by one OSM user (danctc) on 2025-11-06 (174297625, 174297760, 174297826, 174297902, 174298479, 174298489, 174298500, 174298643), all tagged source=SEMA-MT, with no discussion comments. No permission for SEMA-MT data was found (OSM wiki Contributors page and Import/Catalogue: no entry; SEMA-MT site footer: 'Todos os Direitos reservados'). Not counted or shipped until a licence is documented. Checked 2026-11-21. The column total is not counted either. Sum of the other 26 units is not shown for that column. The 27-unit sum is used as the total elsewhere; a single country-wide query timed out on the Overpass server. TO was retried after 502/504 errors and then read successfully.

not_proposed.publisher: ANA (Agência Nacional de Águas e Saneamento Básico)
not_proposed.reason: The metadata record (metadados.snirh.gov.br, opened 2026-11-20) states the licence field as 'O acesso ao dado é livre.' ('Access to the data is free.'). No licence is named, and nothing states that adaptation or commercial use is allowed. It fails the test.
not_proposed.next_step: Ask ANA which licence applies to the BHO and to its dataset page on dadosabertos.ana.gov.br.
not_proposed.second_check: ANA's open data page (opened) says its data are 'disponibilizados livremente … sem restrição de licenças, patentes ou mecanismos de controle'. BHO 6 is v6.2.4 of 2022-10-20 (GeoPackage; drainage 4.06 GB, catchments 20.1 GB: clip per state); BHAE v1.0 (2023-03-28) is a lighter version. Whether ANA's statement is enough is for the maintainers.

not_proposed.reason: The SIAGAS web portal (siagasweb.sgb.gov.br, opened 2026-11-20) shows no licence or terms text. Agreements and reports describe software licences, not data licences. Search results also say full data may need a request. No licence can be read, so it fails the test.
not_proposed.next_step: Ask CPRM for the licence of the SIAGAS data export. Until then, OSM water_well counts stand in.
